nodes.title: verifier.ts
nodes.summary: Verifies the bearer JWT against the issuer's JWKS, then re-checks that the OAuth grant still stands.

lines: * Verifies the bearer JWT against the issuer's JWKS, then re-checks that the OAuth grant still

* nothing in this app can sign one.
export const mcpBearerAuth: MiddlewareHandler<AppEnv> = async (c, next) => {
const { payload } = await jwtVerify(token, jwks, { issuer: adminUrls.issuer, audience: adminUrls.mcpResource });
c.set("principal", { userId: String(payload.sub), clientId: String(payload.azp), scopes: grant.scopes });
